person_relationships.description: Luong Tam Quang is To Lam's protege; succeeded Lam as Minister of Public Security in June 2024
Phan Van Giang serves as Minister of National Defence and Deputy Secretary of the Central Military Commission under Lam
Le Minh Hung serves as Prime Minister under Lam's leadership; Hung's father Le Minh Huong was Lam's former boss at the Ministry of Public Security
Tran Thanh Man serves as Chairman of the National Assembly in Lam's leadership structure
To Lam served under General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong as Minister of Public Security and Deputy Head of the Anti-corruption Steering Committee; succeeded Trong after his death in July 2024

political_stances.stance_content: Published article advocating 'Sharp, compact, strong; High-performance, effective, efficient' government reform, leading to sweeping bureaucratic restructuring including merger of provinces, abolition of district-level administration, and downsizing of government agencies
Pledged annual GDP growth of at least 10% for the remainder of the decade, promising a 'new growth model' led by innovation and digital economy, pivoting away from reliance on cheap labor

Continued and intensified the 'Blazing Furnace' anti-corruption campaign inherited from Nguyen Phu Trong, directing investigations without exceptions while consolidating power over the security apparatus

Signed Resolution No. 57-NQ/TW on breakthroughs in science, technology, innovation, and national digital transformation; established Central Steering Committee on Science, Technology, Innovation, and Digital Transformation chaired by himself
First overseas visit as General Secretary was to China, meeting Xi Jinping; pursued 'bamboo diplomacy' strategy while balancing relations with US, Russia, Japan, India, and other major powers
Attended inaugural meeting of the Gaza Board of Peace in Washington D.C.; met President Trump at the White House; accepted invitation to join US-led Board of Peace as founding member

major_achievements.achievement: Led major anti-corruption investigations as Minister of Public Security, including prosecution of former Politburo member Dinh La Thang and rescue flight/Viet-A COVID-19 scandals
Elected General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam, becoming the country's highest-ranking leader
Completed sweeping administrative reform streamlining Party, National Assembly, and Government agencies; abolished district-level police nationwide; initiated province merger program
Unanimously re-elected General Secretary at the 14th National Party Congress with 180 votes
Elected President of Vietnam by the 16th National Assembly, combining the roles of Party General Secretary and State President

biography_summary: 苏林（To Lam），1957年7月10日出生于越南兴安省文江县，京族，现任越南共产党中央委员会总书记兼越南国家主席，是越南最高领导人。苏林出身公安系统世家，其父苏权曾任海兴省警察局长，获人民武装力量英雄称号。1974年进入人民安全学院学习，此后在公安部工作了四十余年，历任政治保卫一局副局长、局长、安全总局一局局长等职。2010年升任公安部副部长，2011年当选越共中央委员，2016年当选中央政治局委员并出任公安部部长。在公安部部长任上，苏林主持了多起重大反腐败案件的侦办，包括前政治局委员丁罗升案、越亚公司新冠检测试剂丑闻等。2024年5月当选国家主席，同年8月在阮富仲去世后当选越共中央总书记，成为越南最高领导人。执政以来，苏林大力推进行政体制改革，精简政府机构，推动科技创新和数字化转型，提出到2030年实现年均两位数经济增长的目标。2026年1月在越共十四大上连任总书记，同年4月当选国家主席，实现了党政一体的领导格局。苏林拥有法学博士学位和安全科学教授职称，警衔为人民公安大将。其妻吴芳莉为越南电视台前制片人、画家，经常陪同出访。
